recurringPatterns.pattern: Source-limits template governing nearly every evidentiary paragraph
instances: The Uruk tablets cannot establish that every ration recipient was a soldier...
The inscription does not provide a full history of Israel...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Symmetrical two-case comparison ending in a refusal to rank as the engine of almost every chapter
instances: Their evidentiary value cannot be settled by asking which source is simply better.
The two cases resist a simple scale of cruelty or effectiveness.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Enumerated hypothetical triads or quartets filling a possibility space
instances: A threat to burn a house, seize a child, imprison a debtor, expel a family, or withhold food...
People joined from conviction, for survival, revenge, food, or the prospect of a new order...

recurringPatterns.pattern: Chapter-closing recapitulation listing named exhibits in series then restating the thesis
instances: The Uruk ration tablets and Lagash barley accounts show...; the Victory Stele of Naram-Sin and the Merneptah Stele show...
Human aggressiveness has no single historical trajectory: the force described in Raymond's Jerusalem, Augustine's criteria...

recurringPatterns.pattern: 'Same instrument, two faces' antithesis as a substitute for fresh analysis
instances: The same route could reduce raiding and extend extraction.
The same road that carried grain could carry troops.

summary: Unusually disciplined argument sustained across fifteen chapters; severe monotony: exhibit, establishes, cannot establish, paired comparison, refusal to rank; closing paragraphs recap in a fixed shape; almost no sustained scenes or direct quotation.
